newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbia Eksimbanka posts 2.3mln dinar profit in 96.
newsitem.headline: Serbia Eksimbanka posts 2.3mln dinar profit in 96.

text.p: Serbia's Export-Import bank Eksimbanka reported on Wednesday 2.33 million dinars in gross profits for 1996 and said it would pay an 8.79 percent dividend to its shareholders.
The bank did not issue comparative 1995 profit figures.
After setting aside 1.44 million dinars for a special reserve fund and 0.16 million dinars for taxes and contributions, the bank remained with 728,000 dinars to pay dividend to its 58 shareholders.
The bank's assets grew in 1996 to 143.84 million dinars compared to 66.21 million dinars in 1995. Its capital and long-term reserves doubled over the period to 15.57 million dinars from 7.98 million.
Eksimbanka plans a 10 percent increase in its 1997 gross profits, expected to reach 2.57 million dinars.

The bank was founded on December 25, 1991 but started full operations in early 1995. Investbanka is the largest shareholder with 46.6 percent stake. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
